CORRECTION.low_confidence_has_no_alternatives: WRONG in the offline_validation.low_confidence_tie_breaks framing below: all 15 LOW rows genuinely have an EMPTY ambiguous_with -- this is not a bug, it reflects the underlying method: LOW means 'exactly one name-matched candidate, never confirmed by any causal signal', not 'multiple candidates tied'. A separate AMBIGUOUS confidence value exists in the crosswalk builder for real ties and is used by ZERO of the 330 controls. There is no tie to break for Phase 3A; the low_confidence_tie_breaks list below should be read only as 'these 15 rows' best-and-only guess', not as a set of alternatives to choose between.
